title: Podcast RSS, Host Contacts & Transcript Extractor Input

applePodcastIds.title: Apple Podcasts IDs or URLs
applePodcastIds.description: List of Apple Podcasts numeric IDs (e.g. '1584274529') or Apple Podcasts URLs to resolve via the iTunes Lookup API.

searchQueries.title: iTunes Podcast Search Queries
searchQueries.description: Search queries resolved to RSS feeds via the public iTunes Search API.

rssUrls.title: Direct Podcast RSS Feed URLs
rssUrls.description: Direct HTTP(S) podcast RSS XML URLs to parse (SSRF-protected with safe redirect validation).

maxEpisodesPerFeed.title: Max Episodes Per Feed
maxEpisodesPerFeed.description: Maximum number of newest matching episodes to extract per podcast feed.

searchLimitPerQuery.title: Feeds Per Search Query
searchLimitPerQuery.description: Maximum number of podcast feeds to resolve per search query.

country.title: iTunes Store Country Code
country.description: Two-letter country code passed to the iTunes Search/Lookup and Apple Reviews APIs (e.g. US, JP, GB).

fetchTranscripts.title: Fetch & Normalize Transcripts
fetchTranscripts.description: Fetch Podcasting 2.0 <podcast:transcript> files (SRT, VTT, JSON, TXT) and normalize into segments + full_transcript.

fetchChapters.title: Fetch Podcasting 2.0 Chapters
fetchChapters.description: Fetch and normalize JSON chapters referenced by <podcast:chapters> tags.

includeTranscriptSegments.title: Include Timestamped Segments
includeTranscriptSegments.description: Include per-cue timestamped segments alongside full_transcript in dataset records.

includeAppleReviews.title: Include Apple Podcasts Customer Reviews
includeAppleReviews.description: Fetch official public Apple Podcasts customer reviews JSON when an Apple Podcasts iTunes ID is available.

onlyWithTranscripts.title: Only Episodes With Transcripts
onlyWithTranscripts.description: Filter output to episodes that include a Podcasting 2.0 transcript (and successfully extracted transcript segments when fetchTranscripts is enabled).

publishedAfter.title: Published After (ISO Date)
publishedAfter.description: Optional ISO-8601 date or timestamp (e.g. '2026-01-01') to include only episodes published on or after that date.

keywordFilter.title: Keyword Filter (Optional)
keywordFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive keyword filter matched against episode title, show notes, podcast title, and extracted transcript text.
